2 Learned counsel for the petitioner had, on earlier occasion, informed us that two officers had given a report to the higher authorities that a case was made out for registration of an FIR, however,
the said report was turned down by a superior officer.

3 Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner on 7 th February 2024, we asked the learned A.P.P to take appropriate instructions from the Additional Commissioner of Police, Malvani Division, Zone-IX, having regard to what was disclosed to us by the learned counsel for the petitioner i.e. the two officers had 16-WP-3298-2023.doc given a recommendation for registration of an FIR, which was turned down by the Superior Officer.

Accordingly, on 2 nd July 2024, we directed the Additional Commissioner of Police to again reconsider his decision after going through the papers as to whether the petitioner's complaint dated 22 nd September 2022 discloses a cognizable offence or not.
4 Today, learned A.P.P on instructions states that the Additional Commissioner of Police has taken a decision to register an FIR on the basis of petitioner's compliant.
She states that pursuant to the said decision, FIR has been registered by Charkop Police Station, Mumbai, on 13 th July 2024.

The sections alleged in the FIR are 406,
420, 465, 467, 468, 471 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned A.P.P has tendered a copy of the FIR registered on the basis of petitioner's complaint.
The same is taken on record.
5 In view of the aforesaid i.e. registration of FIR, 16-WP-3298-2023.doc
learned
counsel for the petitioner does not press this petition and as such, seeks leave to withdraw the same.
6 Petition is accordingly disposed of as withdrawn.
7 We expect that the police will investigate the case fairly, impartially and take the same to its logical end.
8 Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
9 In view of the disposal of the petition, nothing survives for consideration in the interim application.
The same stands disposed of accordingly.
10 All concerned to act on the authenticated copy of this order.

PRITHVIRAJ K. CHAVAN, J. REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
